title: US fixed income closes early at 2:00 p.m. ET while equities run a full session — the last session before the Christmas closure
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule (SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 by this event's own initial research (HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes) and parsed out of the page's embedded RSC payload, because the 2027 tab is a hidden panel whose text the rendered page drops. The US 2027 Christmas card renders as three consecutive leaves — 'Christmas Day' / 'Friday, December 24, 2027' / 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Thursday, December 23, 2027'. PANEL ATTRIBUTION VERIFIED FIRST-HAND, not inherited: the payload run this card sits in is US-only and Eastern-Time-only (Labor Day 'Monday, September 6, 2027', Columbus Day 'Monday, October 11, 2027', Veterans Day 'Thursday, November 11, 2027', Thanksgiving early close 'Friday, November 26, 2027'), where the UK panel's 2027 Christmas row reads 'Christmas Day' / 'Friday, December 24, 2027' / 'Boxing Day' / 'None' and every Japan card carries a 'Tentative - Subject to confirmation by the Bank of Japan' note this one lacks. The complete 2027 US early-close set this parse returns is Thu 2027-03-25, Fri 2027-05-28, Fri 2027-07-02, Fri 2027-11-26, Thu 2027-12-23 and Fri 2027-12-31, with MLK (Mon 2027-01-18), Presidents Day (Mon 2027-02-15), Juneteenth (Fri 2027-06-18), Labor Day, Columbus Day and Veterans Day carrying no note as the negative control. THE EQUITY SIDE, re-fetched the same session: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes) carries exactly four early-close footnotes across 2026-2028 — Mon 2028-07-03, the three day-after-Thanksgiving dates (2026-11-27, 2027-11-26, 2028-11-24), and Thu 2026-12-24 — and NONE of them names any December 2027 date; its 2027 Christmas row reads 'Friday, December 24 (Christmas Day observed)' with no footnote marker. So on 2027-12-23 NYSE runs a full 09:30-16:00 session and SIFMA recommends fixed income out at 14:00. Filed estimate on the standing three counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for a trade association's or an exchange operator's own hours page, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and SIFMA's closes are recommendations to member firms rather than a market-wide halt. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: READ THIS FIRST — THIS ID AND sifma-bond-early-close-2027-12-23 ARE THE SAME SESSION, AND IF ONE IS RETIRED IT SHOULD BE THIS ONE. Two adjacency sweeps discovered SIFMA's 2027-12-23 recommendation on the same day (2026-09-08) and named it differently: thanksgiving-half-day-2027-11-26 proposed it as bond-market-early-close-2027-12-23 (kind 'sector'), christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24 proposed it as sifma-bond-early-close-2027-12-23 (kind 'rates'). Both are due never-assessed today and each has its own matrix job. #1717's proposer-namespaced filename rule prevents the add/add CONFLICT but not the DUPLICATE EVENT: the calendar's only dedupe key is the id string, and `event-scan.mjs --validate` passes both with zero errors (504 events, 463 ledgers on this branch). The sifma-* id is the convention-consistent survivor — all 11 canonical SIFMA-schedule entries carry that prefix and kind 'rates' — so this row is the one to prune; this file exists because docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md instructs a never-assessed lane to write the canonical for its own assigned id, and the research in the ledger is about the SESSION and survives either id. AND IT IS NOT THE ONLY ONE: a same-date id-similarity scan across all 494 distinct events (canonical + proposal-backed) run this session returns THREE genuine duplicate pairs — this one, fed-waller-outlook-2026-09-03 vs waller-economic-outlook-2026-09-03 (one Reuters NEXT interview, same kind, same impact, two ledgers), and census-benchmark-revision-nsa-2026-09-28 vs retail-benchmark-revision-2026-09-28, whose own title already reads '(DUPLICATE of census-benchmark-revision-nsa-2026-09-28; same Census release)' and which is still in the calendar anyway — plus one true negative it correctly does not merge (treasury-buyback-cash-mgmt-2026-09-09 vs treasury-buyback-increase-2026-09-09, an operation and a size-change effective date). All three pairs pass --validate, all six ids carry their own ledger, and each duplicate doubles every future pulse for its session. Filed as its own issue with the scan. CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09). The one proposal it shadows, proposals/bond-market-early-close-2027-12-23.from-thanksgiving-half-day-2027-11-26.json, was read first and stays where it is; every claim in `source` was re-fetched rather than inherited. WHAT THE LEDGER MEASURED THAT NO SIBLING HAD: the 14:00 ET bond close is NOT the mechanism behind the quiet holiday session. Maundy Thursday — identical hours (equities full, SIFMA bonds 14:00) but no holiday week around it — is an ORDINARY session across 33 years (SPY volume 0.935x its trailing-20 median, above-normal in 14 of 33, p = 0.49; TLT |move| 11 of 23, p = 1.00), while the last session before the Christmas closure is thin and calm (SPY volume 0.767x, 2 of 15 above normal, p = 0.0074; SPY |move| 0.467x, 3 of 15, p = 0.035) and the pre-Memorial-Day Friday is too. The early bond close is common to all three; the holiday week is not. So the 'recommended early close ⇒ quiet tape' reading that runs through this whole class of sibling entries is unsupported by its own control. IMPACT low and symbols [] match every sibling: a recommended early close changes how a session is READ, never what to do — and a re-grep of docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md this session for holiday|christmas|half.?day|early.?close|closure|santa|calendar returns 6 hits, ALL of them the earnings calendar (S1/S2 slice notes and sweep-window caveats) and NONE a holiday or session-hours key, so nothing in the house system can fire on this date in either direction. HONEST LIMIT ON THE KIND FIELD: EventKind in src/domain/market-events-types.ts has no market-structure member; 'sector' is kept as the proposer chose it (matching christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24 and thanksgiving-half-day-2027-11-26), and the fact that the duplicate pair disagrees on kind is part of the finding above, not a separate defect. SECOND HONEST LIMIT: whether CME's rate futures keep separate hours that afternoon is NOT asserted — cmegroup.com has 403'd this runner in every sibling lane and was not re-attempted. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry. Full ledger: docs/research/events/bond-market-early-close-2027-12-23.md
